title: SonicWall - Dropped Traffic
description: Everything the firewall dropped, and the part that matters: drops other than TCP connection teardown (the aborts and rejects of connections that are already closing, which are most of the volume). Shows who sent the blocked traffic, where it was going, on which service, and under which access rule. Internal hosts blocked going out to the WAN are the ones worth a closer look.
